newsitem.title: USA: Vulcan sees higher quarterly EPS ahead.
newsitem.headline: Vulcan sees higher quarterly EPS ahead.

text.p: Vulcan Materials Co said Monday it expects quarterly earnings for the remainder of 1997 to improve from year-earlier le3vels despite a significant decline in earnings from its chemicals business.

Vulcan, which did not provide specific earnings estimates, said it expects lower caustic soda prices to impact earnings in its chemicals business. The outlook for caustic soda prices remains uncertain, it added.
The lower chemicals earnings will be offset by higher earnings in its chlorinated organic products business and its business systems unit, Vulcan said.
